g.title: ESP32
g.text: ESP32 devboard (ESP-WROOM-32, USB-C), socketed on the carrier
Only the pins used on this sheet are shown. USB = micro-ROS link (UART0, 921600). Unused: GPIO36 battery ADC, GPIO39 rain, GPIO13/27 debug console (no adapter on the mower). GPIO2 = status LED.

g.title: HCT245
g.text: 74ACT245 buffer at 5 V (proposed; 3.3 V in, 5 V out, 24 mA)
The DM542T inputs take 7-16 mA; the 74HCT245 is specified to 6 mA, the ACT to 24 mA (same pinout)

g.title: J_DRV_L
g.text: pluggable screw terminal; the minus pins are GND, ENA+ is not driven yet

g.title: J_DRV_R
g.text: pluggable screw terminal; the minus pins are GND, ENA+ is not driven yet

g.title: J_BLADE
g.text: 5 V from the buffer = run, 0 V = stop; pull-down on GPIO18

g.title: DRV_L
g.text: Manual: optocoupler inputs, 270 ohm inside, 4-5 V, 7-16 mA; ENA open = enabled; +V 20-50 V. ENA is not driven by the firmware yet

g.title: DRV_R
g.text: Manual: optocoupler inputs, 270 ohm inside, 4-5 V, 7-16 mA; ENA open = enabled; +V 20-50 V. ENA is not driven by the firmware yet

g.title: BLD
g.text: Owned unit is V2.4x or V3.0 (maker page): it runs with EN open, so EN is not the run signal. Run = 5 V on SV, stop = SV under 0.3 V (manual 4.1); a 1 kOhm resistor across SV and GND in the terminal block holds SV at 0 V if the wire breaks; top speed set with the R-SL pot. EN, F/R, BK, PG, ALM unused. MA=U, MB=V, MC=W

g.title: BLADE
g.text: 8 bare leads, 300 mm; shaft 8 mm D-cut, 25 mm long (maker page); printed blade disc on a flange coupling (to buy)
